items.title: vibe-wise
items.description: A Claude Code plugin that helps you learn how to build while AI writes the code.
items.summary: Vibe-wise is a Claude Code plugin designed to help users learn how to build applications while AI writes the code. It emphasizes learning by putting the user in control, asking for their approach first, discussing tradeoffs, and explaining unfamiliar concepts before writing any code. The plugin aims to make users actively involved in the design and decision-making process, ensuring they understand the code being generated. It is useful for walking through design checkpoints, learning unfamiliar stacks, and designing data schemas before any code is written. The plugin is described as forcing users to learn rather than providing all the answers, ensuring they remain engaged and informed throughout the coding process.

items.title: mcp-extensions
items.description: Build plugins that feel like native, first-class features of ChatGPT.
items.summary: The sources indicate that mcp-extensions is an open-source SDK provided by OpenAI to help developers build plugins that integrate seamlessly with the user experience of ChatGPT. It allows plugins to function as native, first-class features by hooking into key surfaces such as the sidebar, composer, and file viewers. The toolkit supports sidebar entrypoints, file extension handlers, composer mentions, and richer forms, enabling plugins to live outside the chat bubble and offering features like ETag-based conflict detection for file handlers and structured settings rendered as native controls. The GitHub repository for mcp-extensions has 237 stars and is under an Apache-2.0 license.

items.title: strands-decider
items.description: A small, fast decision model, or system one model, for agentic workflows. Pick between options or rate on a scale faster than an LLM, with a calibrated confidence on every decision.
items.summary: Strands Decider 2B is a 2-billion parameter decision model published by Strands Labs, designed to run locally and return confidence-scored choices in tens–low hundreds of milliseconds. It is open source, with weights and training scripts published, and is intended to offload routine, high-volume decisions from expensive large language model calls, lowering cost and making agent tool calls safer. Unlike large language models, decision models are designed to pick between sets of options and assign reliability scores, making them perfect for agentic workflows but unsuited for complex problem-solving or text generation tasks. AWS released this model to facilitate agentic development, aiming to build everything an agent needs except the brains, working alongside larger language models.

The name BootLoops refers to its origin in computing scattering amplitudes in quantum field theory.

items.title: EvoVLM
items.description: Evolving Multimodal Inference Programs: LLM-guided evolutionary search for accurate and efficient vision-language inference.
items.summary: The sources indicate that EvoVLM involves evolutionary search guided by large language models (LLMs) to discover advanced reasoning strategies in vision-language models without explicit programming. This approach demonstrates that LLMs can serve as effective mutation operators in evolutionary search, creating a form of "cognitive bootstrap" where the LLM's capabilities are used to evolve prompts that enhance the model's performance. The combination of LLMs and evolutionary computing opens up new research avenues, including evolutionary prompt optimization, LLM-guided evolutionary algorithms, and co-evolution of LLMs and evolutionary computing techniques.

items.title: RemoveMacAI
items.description: Turn off Apple Intelligence on macOS 27 and get its disk space back. One command, fully reversible.
items.summary: To turn off Apple Intelligence on macOS 27 and reclaim its disk space, execute the following terminal commands in macOS Recovery: `rm -rf /Volumes/Data/System/Library/AssetsV2/com_apple_MobileAsset_UAF_FM_GenerativeModels` and `rm -rf /Volumes/Data/System/Library/AssetsV2/com_apple_MobileAsset_UAF_FM_Visual`. After running these commands, restart your system. The sources indicate that this process can recover significant storage space, typically around 29 GB, but note that macOS 27 still downloads data for EU users and may hide options to disable functionality.

items.summary: TIRx Harness is an open compiler harness for agentic GPU programming, combining a minimal stable compiler foundation, a knowledge base, tools, and a benchmark server to help agents develop correct, fast GPU kernels. It includes a workflow that connects to a knowledge base, compiler analyses, the TIRx foundation, and a benchmark server, with evolution traces and optimized kernels feeding self-improvement. The repository can be installed via `python -m pip install tirx-harness`, and the documentation provides details on installation, quick start, and optimization runs. On evaluated workloads, Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) kernels achieve geometric-mean speedups of 2.94× over FlashKDA (forward) and 6.84× over Flash Linear Attention (FLA) (backward).

items.title: Tame_3D
items.description: Tame3D research framework: evidence-grounded multi-agent 3D reasoning with scene-level conformal uncertainty alignment
items.summary: The sources describe MAG-3D as a multi-agent framework for 3D understanding that employs multi-agent grounded reasoning. The framework includes a planning agent, a grounding agent, and a coding agent, which collaboratively enable flexible training-free 3D grounded reasoning across diverse scenes. The agents communicate through a shared Scene Memory, which maintains an updated record of the reasoning state, ensuring that every step is verified against the physical environment. The paper was submitted on April 10, 2026, and is authored by Henry Zheng, Chenyue Fang, Rui Huang, Siyuan Wei, Xiao Liu, and Gao Huang.

items.title: kantor-agent
items.description: Kantor Agent: kantor 3D tanpa konfigurasi yang menampilkan Claude Code & subagent-nya bekerja (plugin Claude Code)
items.summary: The sources indicate that Kantor Agent, specifically "kantor 3D tanpa konfigurasi yang menampilkan Claude Code & subagent-nya bekerja (plugin Claude Code)," is a visualization tool that shows the operations of Claude Code and its subagents in real-time. The GitHub repository for "claude-office" describes it as a real-time pixel art office simulation that visualizes the operations of Claude Code agents, including boss and employee agents, multi-floor building navigation, and visual state indicators. The YouTube video suggests that subagents are preferred for isolated tasks and that agents can be combined into workflows through commands. The sources do not provide a definitive answer to the specific query about the current state or configuration of the Kantor Agent.

items.title: dsh-jev-plugin
items.description: Native DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin integrating TypeSafe Jev as a System One decision layer for agent selection, supervision, corrections, and approvals.
items.summary: The sources indicate that Aurora Mobile (JG) has integrated Jev, TypeSafe AI’s “System One” decision model, into its enterprise AI agent platform GPTBots.ai to create a two-layer AI architecture. Additionally, Aurora Mobile's AI media platform Modellix.ai has released dsh-modellix, a beta plugin for DeepSeek Harness, allowing Harness users to access LLMs through Modellix's gateway. TypeSafe AI's Jev is positioned as a complementary layer for structured decisions that need speed, type safety, calibrated confidence, and low cost, and it does not generate strings but produces typed, structured outputs with calibrated confidence scores.

items.title: codex-mobile-dev-plugin
items.description: A Codex plugin for a better mobile development experience for android and iOS
items.summary: The sources do not mention a "codex-mobile-dev-plugin" specifically designed for a better mobile development experience for Android and iOS. However, they do discuss Codex plugins and tools that facilitate mobile app development. The Firecrawl plugin registers an MCP server with tools for search, scrape, crawl, and interact, plus skills that teach Codex when to use each tool. Additionally, a video by Riley Brown demonstrates building a simple iOS app using Codex, and another video by Code with Beto shows building a real mobile app on both iOS and Android using Codex without coding. These sources suggest Codex's potential for mobile app development but do not provide a definitive answer regarding the existence of a specific "codex-mobile-dev-plugin."
